newsitem.title: UK: One in four UK households see better economy - GfK.
newsitem.headline: One in four UK households see better economy - GfK.

text.p: Only 25 percent of British households expect the economic situation to improve over the next year, according to September's survey conducted by GfK for the European Union.
A mere two percent of households survey said the economy will get a lot better in the next 12 months, while 23 percent said the improvement would be slight.
The largest number, 40 percent, said the economic situation would remain roughly the same while 19 percent expected some deterioration.

Asked about the economic situation over the past 12 months, 21 percent of households said the economy had improved, 39 percent said the situation was unchanged and 35 percent said the economy was in worse shape than a year ago.
